newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Consolidated in search deal with De Beers.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated in search deal with De Beers.

text.p: Consolidated Gold NL said on Monday that it reached a farm-out agreement with Stockdale Prospecting Ltd, a unit of De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd, covering diamond exploration in two permits in the North Coolgardie mineral region of Western Australia.
The company said Stockdale could earn a 60 percent interest in each permit by spending A$100,000 on exploration within three years.
It said the exploration licences covered an area of approximately 92 square kilometres and were located about 40 kilometres southwest of Consolidated Gold's Kookynie gold mining operations.
Stockdale's initial exploration programme would consist of acquiring airborne magnetic data over the area and further study of targets.
